25.explanation: The late-August 2026 Bhote Koshi flood came from an ice-avalanche-triggered collapse of a supraglacial lake in Tibet, which sent a glacial surge down the river into Nepal. It was not a landslide dam, barrage or reservoir failure.

sources.title: PreventionWeb: When a mountain falls – how ice and rock triggered Nepal's catastrophic flood

26.explanation: Tunnel-rescue teams from India, China and South Korea worked with Nepali forces at the flooded hydropower tunnels.

sources.title: Water Power Magazine: Tunnel rescue efforts continue at flood-hit Nepal hydropower projects

27.explanation: The flood ran down the Bhote Koshi (Rasuwa) into the Trishuli corridor.

sources.title: Kathmandu Post: Bhote Koshi flood was one of region's largest disasters

28.explanation: About 12 operating plants (around 431 MW) and 15 projects under construction (around 470 MW) were damaged.

sources.title: Columbia CGEP: Nepal floods test resilience of its hydropower-dependent economy
